objective.name: sandbox.dsl.aggregate.params.matter.meaning
objective.description: Aggregate final params from one wrapper output, one matter.read payload, and one read.meaning payload before the final wrapper call.

#root.role: Build one wrapper record, read one local matter, read one local meaning descriptor, and synthesize final wrapper params from all three sources.

effects.wrapper_param_source: One local wrapper output contributes to the final params.
effects.matter_param_source: One local matter.read payload contributes to the final params.
effects.meaning_param_source: One local read.meaning payload contributes to the final params.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one final wrapper input projection whose params are synthesized from one previous wrapper response, one matter.read response, and one read.meaning response.
invariants: The final wrapper call receives label from the root input, message from sandbox.build.record, source_ctx from the local matter functional payload, and meaning fields from read.meaning.
The flow does not mutate the local matter or the meaning descriptor it reads.
success: The terminal payload exposes received_params.label, received_params.message, received_params.source_ctx, received_params.meaning_name, and received_params.meaning_description.
received_params.message is prefixed by sandbox.build.record and the meaning fields match the objective section read from sandbox.echo.
failure: The flow fails if sandbox.build.record, matter.read, or read.meaning fails before the terminal wrapper call.
The flow fails if the selected meaning item does not expose the requested objective fields.
notes: This scenario is used by N7 to validate cross-source param aggregation inside the DSL before one wrapper termination.
The terminal payload shape is intentionally aligned with sandbox.inspect.inputs because that wrapper is used as the final consumer.
